description: This file defines interfaces, data structures, macros, and function prototypes for interacting with D-Bus in a Wi-Fi platform, including bus handle management, component paths, and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: wifi_bus_t
classes.description: Represents a Wi-Fi bus with descriptor and callback multiplexing.

classes.name: parameterValStruct1_t
classes.description: Holds parameter name, value, and data type.

classes.name: name_spaceType1_t
classes.description: Associates a namespace with a data type.

classes.name: dbusDataElement_t
classes.description: Defines a data element with name, type, callback table, and data model properties.

classes.name: componentStruct1_t
classes.description: Contains component name, D-Bus path, remote component info.

classes.name: bus_handle
classes.description: Main structure for managing a D-Bus connection, including callbacks and component info.

methods.name: bus_releaseOpenTelemetryContext
methods.description: Releases the OpenTelemetry context associated with the bus.

methods.name: bus_init
methods.description: Initializes the bus with a given handle.

methods.name: find_destination_path
methods.description: Finds the destination path and component for a given namespace.
